Ross

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: blavaan error: latent difference (change) score model
parts:
Hi Ross,

There was indeed a problem with models where latent variables were indicators of other latent variables (i.e., where there is an lv on each side of a =~ operator). This should now be fixed in the devel version, at least for the example you provided (which was very helpful).

Let me know if you run into more issues here, as I haven't tested out many growth models. I suspect that there will be some limit in jags where, if we have a model with tons of lvs, the sampling becomes very inefficient.

Ed
